channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to the contralateral mastoid A1 is equivalent to C4-M1.

channels.label: milo
channels.reason: Milo (mylohyoid) is the submental chin EMG, per the transducer and the EMG-like trace.

channels.label: EOG_sin
channels.reason: Left EOG (sin) referenced to A2, per label and transducer, maps to the left outer canthus channel.

channels.label: cannula
channels.reason: Nasal cannula pressure in mBar, with a respiratory trace.

channels.label: toracico
channels.reason: Toracico is the thoracic piezo effort belt, per the transducer; the trace type was unclassified.

channels.label: ekg
channels.reason: EKG channel with an ECG-like trace.

channels.label: deltoide
channels.reason: Deltoid arm EMG has no canonical target.

channels.label: Heart_Rate_Varia
channels.reason: Heart rate variability in bpm/s is a derived index, not heart rate.

channels.label: Flattening
channels.reason: Flow flattening index derived from the cannula is not a raw signal.

channels.label: Flow
channels.reason: This is flow derived from the same nasal cannula already mapped to nas_pres, not an independent airflow sensor.
